column1: # PEANUTS: "ACNH 60 FPS + SpeedFix" v1.4.5 by tmouh (https://github.com/tmouh/acnh-60fps), CC BY-NC 4.0: see NOTICE.md. Its main IPS for 3.0.3 (FF1D1C05670DB6021C85B624A710B963.ips), converted unchanged
# to cut rows <image offset> <original bytes> <new bytes> (dm/tools/ips_rows.py, with the comments of its speedfix_main.pchtxt); read by ../patches.py VARIANT_CUTS['60']
# Model animation default step (models without their own rate): frames per update 1.0 -> 0.5
# River surface ripples (1469c10): spawn check on update counts that are multiples of 10 -> 20
# River foam spawner 1469050: called every update -> on even update counts only (stub in padding)
# Door approach (NPC Act::cStructureIn, player DoorIn, GoInFittingRoom): minimum step per update 0.2 -> 0.1
# Wind sway of items hanging on trees (fruit, money-tree bags): phase per update 6 -> 3 degrees x wind
# Point light flicker (mCycleA / mCycleB): phase per update pi x cycle -> pi/2 x cycle
# Fishing bite window (fish State::cHit): countdown step -1.0 -> -0.5
# Dialogue text speed: letters per update 1.2 -> 0.6 (hold B 2.4 -> 1.2; CJK 2/3 -> 1/3, 2.0 -> 1.0)
# Dialogue text speed, per-conversation reset: 1.2 -> 0.6, hold B 2.4 -> 1.2, CJK 2/3 -> 1/3, 2.0 -> 1.0
# Dialogue pause tags (timed in 1/60 s): countdown per update 2 -> 1
# Hop over holes and streams (JumpValley 230eab0): duration counted in updates, doubled (frames + frames)
# Pole vault (LongStickJump 239c7a0): jump duration counted in updates, doubled (fcvtzu #1 = frames x 2)
# Warp pipe jump in (23ea320) and pop out (23ee2d0): duration doubled (fcvtzu #1), fallback 18 -> 36 updates
# Sea entry and exit (EnterInWater, JumpOutWater; mover 23693c8): duration doubled (fcvtzu #1 = frames x 2)
# Villager stand waits and HHP villager waits (wait, wait-action, chair/bed seconds): seconds x 30 -> x 60
# Fishing float cast (1640998): vy x1/2, gravity x1/4, chase 0.11 -> 0.0566, max/min step 10/0.4 -> 5/0.2
# Fish shadow Wait state (12b407c): action counter step 1.0 -> 0.5 per update (durations = seconds x 30)
# Fish shadow DriftRiver / DriftSea timers (+0x42c): counter step 1.0 -> 0.5 per update
# Particle effects (nn::vfx emitter set update 23de30): frame rate per update x1/2 (in 2 alignment nops)
# Villager timers in shops, museum, tailor, HHP hotel and Pascal (rand x 30 + base frames): x 60, bases x2
# Tree shake step-in (TreeSwingReady 23e0718): grab motion starts after 7 -> 14 updates
# Walk / run / dash animation choice (thresholds 0.7 / 1.25 / 1.8): speed per update passed in x2
# UI time step (every layout animation and UI control): frames per update 1.0 -> 0.5
# Environment clock and plant wind sway (153b670): frames / 30 -> / 60 for seconds and the 3 wind phases
# choice list post-selection wait 14 -> 28 (no-wait value 15 -> 29), quest jingle holds 20 -> 40 updates
# Animalese voice scheduler: timeline advance per update 1600 -> 800 samples, syllable length unchanged
# Fish timers: hooked fish fight counter (+0x43c) step 1.0 -> 0.5, aquarium fish countdown -1.0 -> -0.5
# Villager frame timers x2 (stand waits, NpcFollower countdown +0x1bc, activity waits, seasonal events)
# axe step-in 11 -> 22, slingshot drop 120 -> 240 updates, put-away shrink wait frames - 3 -> frames - 6
# Camera app first-person yaw: speed x1/2, accel cap x1/4, chase 0.5 -> 0.296875, decay 0.6 -> sqrt(0.6)
# Field items dropped from trees, rocks and balloons: launch velocity matches the normal game at common instants
# Animation-sequence effect and sound triggers: frame passed to the trigger compare x1/2 (stub in padding)
# Rock hits: item window countdown (field-object record +0x6a) 270 -> 540 updates
# Number roll (SimpleNumCounter 3353b14): step per update = distance / 15 -> / 30
# Bell / mile / Poki / ticket popups (*TimerWait): hold after the number roll 20 -> 40 updates
# Fish shadow swim mover (12b90c8): chase 0.05 -> 0.0253, heading 0.2 -> 0.1056, step cap 0.3 -> 0.15
# Fish shadow water-flow drift (Wait, DriftRiver, DriftSea): position += flow x 0.2 -> x 0.1 per update
# Fish shadow drift swim (12b9488): step 0.08 -> 0.04 units per update
# Fish shadow approach to the float (Pick, state 6): chase 0.15 -> 0.078, cap 0.35 -> 0.175 per update
# Hooked fish wobble (Captured, state 8): phase 20 -> 10 degrees per update
# Fishing float during the fight (Fight 164179c): blend toward the fish 0.04 -> 0.02 per update
# Catch pull-out (RodCatch 23b79c4): start delay 4 -> 8 updates, fish scale blend 0.05 -> 0.025 per update
# Catch pull-out: fish arc and scale ramp length (rodata 4002e40) 12 -> 24 updates
# Catch pull-out tables (4b48308, 8 x 5): vy x1/2, gravity x1/4, chase 1 - sqrt(1 - r), floor/cap x1/2
# Fishing float Catch tables (4076d3c, 6 x 5): vy x1/2, gravity x1/4, chase 1 - sqrt(1 - r), floor/cap x1/2
# Fishing float Catch launch (16422b4): distance term of the upward speed x0.2 -> x0.1
# velocity chase 0.5 -> 0.296875, pitch chase 0.25 -> 0.1328125 (nearest fmov to 1 - sqrt(1 - r))
# Fishing float bob while waiting (Drift state): phase 0.2 -> 0.1 radians per update
# Crafting and cooking item pops: burst length 100 -> 200 updates, pop times rand(0..99) -> rand(0..199)
# Warp pipe entry turn: step per update max 30 -> 15, min 0.5 -> 0.25 degrees, snap window +-0.5 -> +-0.25
# Furniture leaf shaken from a tree (item state 16): flight 50 -> 100 updates, flutter phase per update x1/2
# Villager wait duration (setter +0x308, brain +0xae5c): n x 30 -> n x 60 frames (shift and subtract)
# Villager queued short waits (goal type 1, duration +0xec): 30 -> 60 updates
# Automatic tool pull-out (ToolPullout): animation event interval in updates x2 (fcvtzu #1)
# wait 10 + rand(0..49) -> 20 + rand(0..99), stopping decay on even updates only (stubs in padding)
# Aquarium fish paths: AntiStream height step x1/2, pitch gain 0.03 -> 0.0151, RoundsSwimming bob x1/2
# Aquarium fish turning: pitch return 0.03 -> 0.0151, Round / KeepSwimming gain 0.1 -> 0.0513, roll cap x1/2
# Museum water insects: pose gain per unit of speed, beetle 1.5 -> 3.0, skater 1.2 -> 2.4 (speed is x1/2)
# Bug animation and movement: speeds x1/2, acceleration x1/4; corrected launch velocity uses saved scratch registers
# Separate layout runtime (lytManager::calc, e.g. the ABD keypad): time step per update 1.0 -> 0.5
# Menu key repeat (common input context): initial hold 10 -> 20 updates, repeat interval 4 -> 8 updates
# Item preview rotation (shared handler 32baa58: design editor, shops, catalogs, crafting): 10 -> 5 deg per update
# D-pad roll: target x1/2, accel caps x1/4, rate 0.5 -> 0.296875, decay 0.5 -> 0.71875 (nearest fmov values)
# Choice list opening (SelectMessageWindowTalkPage state 2): 4 extra updates before ready (counter from -5)
# Pocket commands (cPocketMenu): popup-closed and first-dispatch holds 1 -> 2 updates, drop wait 5 -> 10
# Warp pipe exit (JumpOut 23ee2d0), local player: first fade-in call at mPipeExitFadeInDelayFrame + 4 updates
# Wasp swarm hover before the chase (InsectActionFieldBee Wait): 60 -> 120 updates
# Wasp-nest shock turn (EmotionEffectAction): rate 0.25 -> 0.1338 (1 - sqrt(1 - r)), cap 20 -> 10 degrees
# Pocket close (cPocketMenu state 4): held 5 more updates after the Out animation ends (stubs in padding)
# Jump into the sea from a height (JumpInWater): vy chase floor 0.05 -> 0.0125, y chase floor 0.5 -> 0.25
# Warp pipe entry (JumpIn 23ea320), local player: jump-in motion start at state update 0 -> 1
# Birds (BbsBirdActor 74916c): day state durations = animation frames x2 (fcvtzu #1)
# Wasp-nest shock turn: snap window and minimum step 2 -> 1 degree per update
# Pick-up balloon: pickable-item search resumes after 5 -> 10 updates of Wait
# Title screen idle timeout (TitlePage cIdle): 1800 -> 3600 updates
# Released fish vanish (cRelease): visual scalar +0x2a0 step per update 1/15 -> 1/30, 0.05 -> 0.025
# Cloud shadow and interior projector oscillators (aglprojsdw 39b6e60): phase per update x1/2 (2pi -> pi)
# Wind gust (sound/environment update 292dd60): relaxation gain toward the target 0.01 -> 0.005 per update
# Wind peak hold (read by plant sway and decor): decay 0.02 -> 0.01 per update
# Cloud wind-speed sampling: interval is twice the normal game's whole-update interval
# Dialogue window close (Out state 6): 10 extra updates after the window reports closed (counter -11 to -1)
# Event flow WaitFrame (both node types): wait N + 1 -> 2N + 2 updates (N authored in 30 FPS frames)
# Pitfall struggle (PitfallStruggle): escape limit 300 -> 600 (idle adds 1 per update)
# Pitfall struggle: button press weight 6 -> 11.5 (truncated to 11, net gain over idle 5 -> 10)
# Reaction emotes with auto-end (dialogue, event-flow; helper 2438020): wait 31 -> 63 (32 -> 64 updates)
# Automatic tool pull-out and other scheduled animations: layout frames and animation-open offsets x2
# Tool pull-out turn (ToolPullout): rate 0.28 -> 0.1478, snap 1 -> 0.5, cap 25 -> 12.5 degrees per update
# Scripted turns (DemoTurn 2291bdc): rate 0.28 -> 0.1478, snap 1 -> 0.5, cap 25 -> 12.5 degrees per update
# Fishing float river drift (RodWaitHit 23b46a4): position += flow x 0.2 -> x 0.1 per update
# scroll speed per update 15 / 9 -> 7.5 / 4.5, ease divisor 10 -> 20
# Timer display colon (3364034): visible for 18 -> 36 updates after each digit change
# Timer HUD hold after 00:00 (MiniGameTimer +0x23c, all 5 seeds): 90 -> 180 updates
# player title, NookPhone, My Designs, Critterpedia in both view modes): hold and repeat updates x2
# hold until 8 updates while the window is open (3 padding islands)
# hold updates per balloon type x2 (table 4080228 and 4 inlined defaults of 150)
# Software keyboard and number keypad hold-repeat (guiKeyInputManager 31aec40): 10 / 4 -> 20 / 8 updates
# K.K. concert camera moves (cTkkLive 7bcb14): 30/s music-frame lengths stored x2 (stub at 7bc244)
# K.K. concert end wait (event-flow TkkLive b23ea0): 60 -> 120 updates, 90 -> 180 on its special date
# NookPhone icon badge cycle on the HUD (SmartPhoneIcon 312dc08): badge switch every 200 -> 400 updates
# turn 0.2 -> 0.1 degrees per update, ease, sway, swing and drift steps halved
# waits 11 updates instead of 2, restoring the 0.33 s pause
# K.K. first live closing applause: wait = 2 x (animation frames + 1) updates
# Turning around while moving (Move speed chase 23171c8): reversal gate 6 -> 12 updates
# launch x1/2, gravity x1/4 (stub at 1642bf4), rate 0.08 -> 1 - sqrt(0.92), step limits x1/2
# so the running skid and the stop poses switch clips at the same speeds as at 30 FPS
# Beach camera z-offset ease: the clamped step is no longer doubled
# per update, N = animation frame range; N x2 (fcvtzu #1)
# per update 1/16 -> 1/32 turn (same half-sine push and return)
# Villager waits and behavior state timers: wait durations, state timeouts, countdowns and cooldowns x2
# Villager waits and behavior timers: additional durations x2
# Villager approach, pitfall lead-in and falling motion: restore normal game pace
# Letter opening: preserve the entry delay
# Falling field items: preserve the delay before the landing hop
# Launched field items: rescale gravity for the normal falling arc
# Falling field items: reset the inherited entry delay on state changes
# Clock display: preserve the fade-in delay after actions
# Birds and balloons: rescale movement, shrinking and update-counted waits
# Boat-tour weather: rescale transitions and progress at the chosen frame rate
# Fish: rescale animation transitions, waits and minute-to-update conversion
# Sea creatures: rescale lifetime, waits, acceleration and escape movement
# Actor searches: rescale the search-cone step and its update-count guard together
# Releasing a creature: preserve the delay before it starts moving
# Sound: rescale update-counted waits, playback progress and music fades
# Idle and wait transitions: preserve the character blend-in and blend-out pace
# Launched field items: preserve the pace of tilt settling
# Island tune (villagers humming and whistling, Resident Services chime, doorbell): notes, and the pauses between whistled phrases, keep their normal length
# Animalese villager voice: syllables start on the normal game's cadence, so holding B no longer packs them twice as densely
# Cockroach (GitHub issue #1): runs at its normal speed, with its normal pauses between runs and its normal squash and fade timing
# Talking to residents and shopkeepers: the message window starts opening at its normal moment, so the first line begins after its normal delay (open lead 4 updates x N)
# Ant Wait animation cadence: preserve whole-frame samples at normal 30 fps
